newsitem.title: UK: ICI says still on acquisition trail.
newsitem.headline: ICI says still on acquisition trail.

text.p: Britain's Imperial Chemical Industries Plc said on Monday that it was still interested in further acquisitions despite the recent flurry of activity.

Finance director Alan Spall said in an interview the group was keen to enhance its world-leading position in paints and in the major businesses acquired from Unilever Plc in an $8 billion agreement announced in May.
Spall said: "We have not in any way diminished our enthusiasm for enhancing our leadership position in paints."
And he added that "we are planning a normal pursuit of opportunities in the...acquired major areas."
Spall said that on completion of the sale to DuPont Co, "80 percent of ICI sales will be at the lighter end of the chemical industry."
He said ICI's polyester polymer, Tioxide and polyester film businesses had been sold to a "world class" player.
"It is an excellent strategic fit for DuPont who are committed to the development of these businesses. We see this as a win-win for ICI and DuPont."
